added.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
added.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
added.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.
added.detail: Function `public.aka_agent_facebook_random_run(p_staff_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint, p_auth_username text, p_auth_password text, p_account_id bigint, p_operation text, p_input jsonb)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/aka_agent_facebook_random_run`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
